command:
set -euo pipefail
kubectl -n kcm-system wait restore/qa-configmap-restore --for=jsonpath='{.status.phase}'=Completed --timeout=20s
kubectl -n qa-backup-restore get configmap qa-restore-probe -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d["data"]);assert d["data"]["proof"]=="week1-live-backup-restore"'
kubectl -n kcm-system get restore qa-configmap-restore -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["status"])'
